items.title: Every smooth covering of a scheme is refined by an etale covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a smooth covering {S_i -> S} of a scheme in the sense of the Topologies chapter, the lemma produces an etale covering {T_j -> S} refining it, i.e. the etale topology is contained in the smooth topology in the strongest (refinement) sense. The retained proof is a written point-by-point assembly: every s in S lies in the image of some S_i -> S, the etale-neighbourhood lemma just collected (L16018, lemma-etale-nbhd-dominates-smooth) supplies an etale g_s : T_s -> S with s in its image factoring through S_i -> S, and the assembled family {T_s -> S} is an etale covering refining the original. Retained author proof at lines 10947-10954.
